repositoryPolicy.largeOriginalRule: If original exceeds about 15MB or longest edge exceeds 4000px, keep the original only in /private/tmp for hash verification and commit only a no-crop/no-stretch derivative with longest edge 2400-3200px.

downloadNotes.evidence: Web search and direct official-path HEAD probes for subduction-hires.jpg returned no usable official asset. The repository therefore includes an official NPS Subduction Zones gallery image and an official NOAA public-domain Lau Basin tectonic map, both as real assets rather than placeholders.
